import HartshorneLib.Chapter4SimplePoleResidue

/-!
# The local higher-pole filtration

At a closed point, rational differentials with pole order at most `n` are
defined intrinsically by clearing them with the `n`th power of the maximal
ideal.  This is the local finite-jet domain used by the arbitrary-pole residue
construction.  The level-one piece is the simple-pole lattice already equipped
with its intrinsic residue.
-/

set_option autoImplicit false

universe u

open CategoryTheory AlgebraicGeometry IsLocalRing
open scoped nonZeroDivisors

namespace Hartshorne

noncomputable section

attribute [local instance] functionFieldOverAlgebra stalkOverAlgebra
  stalkFunctionFieldOver_isScalarTower

variable {k : Type u} [Field k]
variable (X : Over (Spec (CommRingCat.of k))) [IsIntegral X.left]

/-- Rational differentials with pole order at most `n` at `x`.  The definition
uses only the maximal ideal and is independent of a chosen uniformizer. -/
def curvePoleDifferentials (x : X.left) (n : ℕ) :
    Submodule (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (CurveRationalDifferentials X) where
  carrier := {ω | ∀ a ∈ maximalIdeal (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) ^ n,
    a • ω ∈ curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x}
  zero_mem' := by simp
  add_mem' := by
    intro ω η hω hη a ha
    simpa only [smul_add] using (curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x).add_mem
      (hω a ha) (hη a ha)
  smul_mem' := by
    intro b ω hω a ha
    simpa only [smul_comm a b] using
      (curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x).smul_mem b (hω a ha)

@[simp]
theorem mem_curvePoleDifferentials_iff (x : X.left) (n : ℕ)
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) :
    ω ∈ curvePoleDifferentials X x n ↔
      ∀ a ∈ maximalIdeal (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) ^ n,
        a • ω ∈ curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x := Iff.rfl

/-- Increasing the allowed pole order enlarges the local differential lattice. -/
theorem curvePoleDifferentials_mono {x : X.left} {m n : ℕ} (hmn : m ≤ n) :
    curvePoleDifferentials X x m ≤ curvePoleDifferentials X x n := by
  intro ω hω a ha
  exact hω a ((Ideal.pow_le_pow_right hmn) ha)

/-- The first level of the intrinsic filtration is exactly the simple-pole
lattice, so the previously constructed residue applies to it. -/
@[simp]
theorem curvePoleDifferentials_one (x : X.left) :
    curvePoleDifferentials X x 1 = curveSimplePoleDifferentials X x := by
  ext ω
  simp [curvePoleDifferentials, curveSimplePoleDifferentials]

/-- Pole order zero means regularity. -/
@[simp]
theorem curvePoleDifferentials_zero (x : X.left) :
    curvePoleDifferentials X x 0 = curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x := by
  ext ω
  constructor
  · intro h
    simpa using h 1 (by simp)
  · intro h a _
    exact (curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x).smul_mem a h

variable [SmoothOfRelativeDimension 1 X.hom]

/-- A power of any specified uniformizer tests the intrinsic pole bound. -/
theorem mem_curvePoleDifferentials_iff_pow_smul {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t)
    (n : ℕ) (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) :
    ω ∈ curvePoleDifferentials X x n ↔
      t ^ n • ω ∈ curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x := by
  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing X.hom hx
  have hpow : maximalIdeal (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) ^ n = Ideal.span {t ^ n} := by
    rw [ht.maximalIdeal_eq, Ideal.span_singleton_pow]
  constructor
  · intro h
    exact h (t ^ n) (hpow.symm ▸ Ideal.subset_span (Set.mem_singleton _))
  · intro h a ha
    rw [hpow, Ideal.mem_span_singleton'] at ha
    obtain ⟨b, rfl⟩ := ha
    simpa only [mul_smul] using (curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x).smul_mem b h

/-- Every rational differential is regular after multiplication by some power
of any local uniformizer. -/
theorem exists_pow_smul_mem_curveRegularDifferentialLattice {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t)
    (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, t ^ n • ω ∈ curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x := by
  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing X.hom hx
  obtain ⟨⟨η, s⟩, hs⟩ := IsLocalizedModule.surj (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)⁰
    (KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField) ω
  obtain ⟨n, v, hv⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.eq_unit_mul_pow_irreducible
    (nonZeroDivisors.coe_ne_zero s) ht
  refine ⟨n, ?_⟩
  have hreg : (s : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) • ω ∈
      curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x := ⟨η, hs.symm⟩
  have h := (curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x).smul_mem (↑v⁻¹) hreg
  simpa [hv, ← mul_smul, ← mul_assoc] using h

/-- The intrinsic pole filtration exhausts the rational differential space. -/
theorem exists_mem_curvePoleDifferentials {x : X.left}
    (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left) (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) :
    ∃ n : ℕ, ω ∈ curvePoleDifferentials X x n := by
  letI := smoothCurve_stalk_isDiscreteValuationRing X.hom hx
  obtain ⟨t, ht⟩ := IsDiscreteValuationRing.exists_irreducible (X.left.presheaf.stalk x)
  obtain ⟨n, hn⟩ := exists_pow_smul_mem_curveRegularDifferentialLattice X hx t ht ω
  exact ⟨n, (mem_curvePoleDifferentials_iff_pow_smul X hx t ht n ω).mpr hn⟩

/-- Clearing a pole with a power of a uniformizer gives a regular rational
differential. -/
def curvePoleRegularization {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) (n : ℕ) :
    curvePoleDifferentials X x n →ₗ[X.left.presheaf.stalk x]
      curveRegularDifferentialLattice X x where
  toFun ω := ⟨t ^ n • (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X),
    (mem_curvePoleDifferentials_iff_pow_smul X hx t ht n ω).mp ω.property⟩
  map_add' _ _ := Subtype.ext (smul_add _ _ _)
  map_smul' a ω := Subtype.ext (smul_comm (t ^ n) a (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X))

/-- The regular local representative of a differential after clearing its
pole with the specified power of a uniformizer. -/
def curvePoleLocalDifferential {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) (n : ℕ) :
    curvePoleDifferentials X x n →ₗ[X.left.presheaf.stalk x]
      CurveStalkDifferentials X x :=
  (curveRegularDifferentialLatticeEquiv X x).symm.toLinearMap.comp
    (curvePoleRegularization X hx t ht n)

@[simp]
theorem curvePoleLocalDifferential_map {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) (n : ℕ)
    (ω : curvePoleDifferentials X x n) :
    KaehlerDifferential.map k k (X.left.presheaf.stalk x) X.left.functionField
      (curvePoleLocalDifferential X hx t ht n ω) =
        t ^ n • (ω : CurveRationalDifferentials X) := by
  exact congrArg Subtype.val ((curveRegularDifferentialLatticeEquiv X x).apply_symm_apply _)

/-- Increasing the clearing exponent multiplies the local representative by
the corresponding power of the parameter. -/
theorem curvePoleLocalDifferential_add {x : X.left} (hx : x ≠ genericPoint X.left)
    (t : X.left.presheaf.stalk x) (ht : Irreducible t) (n m : ℕ)
    (ω : curvePoleDifferentials X x n) :
    curvePoleLocalDifferential X hx t ht (n + m)
      ⟨ω, curvePoleDifferentials_mono X (Nat.le_add_right n m) ω.property⟩ =
        t ^ m • curvePoleLocalDifferential X hx t ht n ω := by
  apply curveDifferentialMap_injective X x
  simp only [map_smul, curvePoleLocalDifferential_map, pow_add, mul_smul]
  exact smul_comm _ _ _

end
end Hartshorne
